name: athenaeum
description: Athena monorepo root: one-stop task runner for the Go server, Solid PWA client, and Electron launcher.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix electron install
scripts.setup: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix electron install
scripts.reset: npm run reset:server && npm run reset:client
scripts.demo: npm run reset:server && npm run build:server && cd server && go run ./cmd/athena-server seed --reset
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
